summary: Required courses must be letter graded where a letter grade is offered. You take the three first-year core courses (ESS 305, 306 and 307) and one course in each of the three distribution areas, for 45 graduate units with your research. Your advisor checks the 3.0 GPA and the four letter-graded graduate courses of at least 3 units from four different faculty, petitioned area courses are moved in by hand, and the research plan and the thesis are approved by the department.
